what_was_done: Separated IBKR submitted orders from confirmed local positions in LiveTradingEngine. A broker order now creates an audit ticket only; it no longer opens a local position or increments confirmed trades before fill.
Added BrokerReconciler to compare IBKR broker state with PaperJournal and block live trading cycles when local broker tickets or claimed positions are not broker-confirmed.
Recorded IBKR perm_id/tws_order_id/client_id end to end through scripts/_ibkr_order.py, InteractiveBrokersAdapter, Order, PaperJournal, and cockpit order rows.
Fixed XP/Pain Memory result registration to use current APIs and learn only from closed position results.
Added closed-market study hook so the autonomous loop can review aged theses and generate standup while the market is closed.
Hardened IBKR open-order refresh against transient empty reads by waiting longer and preserving recent non-empty order cache.
Sanitized /health/details and /metrics JSON output so NaN/Infinity cannot produce 500 responses.
Changed /health/trace/{run_id} to return an empty blame report for valid missing traces instead of causing a browser-visible 404.
